_note: Snapshot of the six needs as worded in Read Anyone v1 (tag v1-full-guide, 10 Nov 2026). Our own paraphrase; used for the Versions block on the Learn need cards.

needs.name: Significance
needs.listen: Talks about what they built, their impact, or standing out.
mightSay: People still come to me for this.
needs.do: Name their specific impact. Then ask what they are proudest of.
needs.avoid: A vague 'that's amazing' or stealing the story with your own win.
needs.line: That took real building. What are you proudest of?
needs.question: Do others see me as making an impact?

needs.name: Approval
needs.listen: Checks in, seeks reassurance, plays themselves down before they start.
mightSay: I am sure I will mess it up.
needs.do: Give clear, specific validation. Say what is good and why.
needs.avoid: Vague praise, or jumping in with a fix before they feel sure.
needs.line: You handled that well — especially [the specific bit].
needs.question: Am I doing this right?

needs.name: Acceptance
needs.listen: We, us, our. Teams, groups, who is in and who is out.
mightSay: We all get on really well.
I do not want to crash a group.
needs.do: Use shared language. Make room for them. Talk about the 'we'.
needs.avoid: Making it all about you, or leaving them on the edge of the circle.
needs.line: You would fit with the people I have in mind for this.
needs.question: Do I belong here?

needs.name: Intelligence
needs.lean: Wants to be seen as smart
needs.listen: Mentions expertise, research, how it works. Tests whether you know it too.
needs.do: Ask for their expert view, and mean it. Let them explain.
needs.avoid: Talking over them, or dumbing it down.
needs.line: I would like your read on this — you know this terrain.
needs.question: Do others see me as sharp?

needs.name: Hardship
needs.lean: Wants it known it has been hard
needs.listen: Talks about what they have been through. Seeks a moment of recognition.
mightSay: You would not believe my week.
Nobody sees what I deal with.
needs.do: Confirm it was hard. Pause so they feel heard. Then gently move on.
needs.avoid: It is not that bad, at least, or instantly problem-solving.
needs.line: That sounds like a heavy stretch. I am glad you said it.
needs.question: Do others realise how hard this has been?

needs.name: Power
needs.listen: Directs the conversation, wants the final say, asks for the headline.
mightSay: Here is how we are doing it.
needs.do: Be short and clear. Let them make the call. Offer options, not a lecture.
needs.avoid: Long preambles, or wrestling them for control.
needs.line: Two options. You choose which we run with.
needs.question: Do I have the final say?
